environments.name: development
environments.purpose: Development and fixture-mode validation of Railway services and managed stores.
environments.provisioning_policy: Allowed after normal review with secret-free examples or Railway-managed references; no production routes, provider aliases, or live retrieval enablement.

environments.name: production
environments.environment_owner: Platform operations owner with Platform lead approval
environments.purpose: First-release production environment after Track 0 approval.
environments.provisioning_policy: Do not provision, deploy, or mutate from this artifact. Creation requires explicit approval, named owners, reviewed secrets, backup validation, and disabled-by-default production capabilities.

migration_execution_policy.development: Run reviewed migrations from a one-shot Railway job or local Railway-run context using the migration role after db:check succeeds.
migration_execution_policy.production: Explicit approval only; require backup/restore evidence, dry-run or plan output, reviewed expand/migrate/contract sequencing, and a single-flight migration job using DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL.
health_after_migration: store SELECT 1 or native readiness probe

services.railway_shape: Container service using upstream Bifrost OSS image or infra\bifrost Dockerfile once approved.
services.start_command: upstream Bifrost container entrypoint with BIFROST_CONFIG_PATH
services.health_expectation: HTTP /health or upstream equivalent; fail closed if registry/policy snapshot cannot load.
services.portable_boundary: HTTP gateway plus config file; provider keys supplied only through environment variables or encrypted store references.

services.health_expectation: HTTP /healthz returns build version; /readyz checks Operational Postgres, Redis, Bifrost, and auth config.
services.portable_boundary: Node HTTP service with Postgres/Redis/OTLP clients.

services.railway_shape: Full-repo monorepo web service for apps\admin-portal.
services.health_expectation: HTTP /healthz or platform static health plus Control API URL and Better Auth origin configuration check.
services.portable_boundary: Web app built from repo context; no direct database or provider-key access.

services.health_expectation: HTTP /healthz checks MCP endpoint readiness, tool registry load, approval-policy freshness, Redis, and Operational Postgres.
services.portable_boundary: HTTP/MCP service with policy-gated tool adapters.

services.railway_shape: Full-repo worker service for workers\agent-runtime plus shared packages.
services.health_expectation: Worker heartbeat writes to Operational Postgres and exposes /healthz when run with HTTP sidecar; readiness checks Redis leases and object storage access.
services.portable_boundary: Python worker using Postgres durable state, Redis short-lived leases, S3 artifacts, and OTLP telemetry.

services.railway_shape: Full-repo worker service for workers\retrieval-indexer plus shared packages.
services.health_expectation: Worker heartbeat plus /healthz sidecar; readiness checks Knowledge Postgres, pgvector, object storage, Neo4j, retrieval toggle validity, context budget/compression controls, ACL metadata, and Bifrost embedding route state.
services.portable_boundary: Python worker using Postgres/pgvector, S3, Neo4j, and OTLP-compatible clients.

services.railway_shape: On-demand Railway job or worker from workers\eval-runner; fixture mode by default.
services.health_expectation: Job exits 0 with gate-shaped result; daemon mode must expose /healthz and verify fixture mode, Operational Postgres, and object storage artifact writes.
services.portable_boundary: Batch job with fixture/provider mode switch guarded by eval variables and gate policy.

services.health_expectation: pg_isready plus SELECT 1; app-level readiness via pnpm db:check before deploy approval.
services.portable_boundary: Standard Postgres connection URLs with separate app, migration, and read-only roles.

services.railway_shape: Railway Postgres service named KnowledgePostgres with pgvector approval before production.
services.health_expectation: pg_isready plus SELECT 1 and pgvector extension check before retrieval/indexing readiness.
services.portable_boundary: Standard Postgres/pgvector schema with exportable source, chunk, vector, and ACL metadata.

services.health_expectation: PING/PONG and namespace TTL smoke checks; Redis never becomes sole durable authority.
services.portable_boundary: Redis protocol only for queues, locks, and rate limits.

services.railway_shape: Railway bucket named ArtifactsBucket or compatible S3 bucket.
services.health_expectation: S3-compatible HeadBucket/ListBucket smoke check with scoped credentials and artifact prefix write/read/delete in development.
services.portable_boundary: S3-compatible endpoint, bucket, region, access key, and secret key variables.

services.railway_shape: Container service with attached Railway volume or portable Neo4j Community deployment.
services.build_command: docker image neo4j:community or approved pinned image
services.start_command: Neo4j container entrypoint with auth and volume variables
services.health_expectation: HTTP/Bolt readiness plus cypher RETURN 1; import/export restore fixture before production.
services.portable_boundary: Bolt/HTTP endpoints and export/import backups; no Railway-only graph APIs.

services.railway_shape: Container service using OpenTelemetry Collector contrib image with config supplied from reviewed artifact.
services.build_command: docker image otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib pinned by digest before production
services.health_expectation: Collector health_check extension on :13133 and OTLP receivers on 4317/4318; exports to Prometheus/logging path in development.

services.railway_shape: Container service with Prometheus config and persistent volume policy before production.
services.build_command: docker image prom/prometheus pinned by digest before production
services.health_expectation: HTTP /-/healthy and /-/ready; scrape targets include Bifrost, Control API, Tool Broker, workers, OTel Collector, and platform exporters where available.
services.portable_boundary: Prometheus scrape and remote-write compatible configuration.

services.railway_shape: Container service with dashboards/config imported from reviewed artifacts.
services.build_command: docker image grafana/grafana-oss pinned by digest before production
services.start_command: Grafana container entrypoint with GF_* variables
services.health_expectation: HTTP /api/health; dashboards for gateway, workflow, retrieval, eval, cost, and SLO views must load from Prometheus datasource.
services.portable_boundary: Grafana OSS dashboard JSON and Prometheus datasource config.
